mapper.select: SELECT T.*, L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM AS REGION_NAME, C.NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT F.FAVORITE_ID) AS FAVORITE_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT R.REVIEW_ID) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM TOUR_PLACE T LEFT JOIN LDONG L ON T.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD = L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD LEFT JOIN CATEGORY C ON T.CATEGORY_ID = C.ID LEFT JOIN FAVORITE F ON T.CONTENT_ID = F.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN REVIEW R ON T.CONTENT_ID = R.CONTENT_ID AND R.REVIEW_ACTIVE = 'Y' WHERE T.CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} GROUP BY T.CONTENT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FAVORITE (USER_ID, CONTENT_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contentId}, NOW())
